name: LOVE SEXLIFE
source:
It has been a few years since my mom passed away. I am living with my dad, sister, and brother. I believed that we are just an ordinary family, but....
One night, the girl finds a "secret" of her older sister.... It made her to have sexual relationship with her teacher.... Who do you prefer, older sister or teacher???

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE018503.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
母亲去世已有好些年头，如今我与父亲、姐姐和弟弟一同生活。我一直以为我们只是个普普通通的家庭，可是……
某个夜晚，少女撞破了姐姐的“秘密”……这也促使她与自己的老师发生了肉体关系……姐姐与老师，你更钟意哪一边？

[摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE018503.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
